notes.title: Demo is out now!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We thank you for your long-term support! We have released the Demo of The World Well: Blood of Caro. From this demo, we are eager to collect feedback and suggestions. Rest assured, it is our promise to polish this game for a better performance in the future based on these suggestions!

We are collecting the feedback SPECIFICALLY on translation, please visit:　https://forms.office.com/r/8G6sQ6NwwU for more information. This game is still in development, please feel welcomed to join our [url=2pgames.net/discord]Discord[/url] (on Visual Novel Group) . We will try our best to bring you an unique experience. Thank you!

notes.title: Well World: Blood of Caro has joined Eastern Game Fes with new DEMO!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719184/05c66426c7c222b111f20d38652027b7cfe9ed8d.jpg[/img]
Dear Players,

The Eastern Game Fest brings hundreds of game with orient taste to you, we are glad that this game is one of them and we bring you a brand-new DEMO!

Well World: Blood of Caro is a combination of Visual Novel and Road-Trip story, 2 girls named "4" and "Noma" met by coincidence, then they share the same journey with seperate purpose, reaching their own inner peace.

We received many reports from our alpha-testers, and we update the artworks after that, including character to background scene, makes this game closer to our expectation.

We redesigned the central characters first:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719184/f373fcd7a7f87b5b098916bcec9d426724bc2f3b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719184/9b03945f62a3e8d798da868ca46201cd31bbf72e.jpg[/img]

Plus, we made a new key visual:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719184/fed133beeb8ee07dddc48426ece3bfd2b71fa5c9.jpg[/img]

In addition, we have optimized and remade many of the game's background images during this period. We also focused more on the game's story-telling, replacing the traditional dialogues with a lot of action and camera language to enhance the gameplay experience for all players. In terms of the game's narrative experience, we've also enhanced the impact of branching options on plot development. As a small workshop that enjoys beautiful girls and adventure stories, we are looking forward to meeting all Galgame lovers at the this event, and we sincerely hope that you will also be able to pick up a white-haired machine girl that falls from the sky someday. XD

Well World: Blood of Caro will be released soon! You can wishlist it and get the latest news about this game!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2648900/_/

2P Games & NimParth Studio
